clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: Meridian shall provide electronic health record integration services to Customer.

clauses.title: Business Associate Agreement
clauses.text: The parties acknowledge that Meridian will be a Business Associate as defined under HIPAA. The Business Associate Agreement attached as Exhibit B is incorporated by reference.

clauses.title: Breach Notification
clauses.text: Meridian shall notify Customer of any breach of unsecured PHI within sixty (60) days of discovery, in accordance with 45 CFR §164.410.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Meridian's aggregate liability shall not exceed three times (3x) the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

clauses.title: Audit Rights
clauses.text: Customer may audit Meridian's compliance with this Agreement and applicable law no more than once per calendar year, with thirty (30) days written notice.

risk_findings.risk: 60-day breach notification at the regulatory ceiling
